items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Yeah, well Jim, Paul Barnes, Sidney Flusia played the guitar, Benny Turner played the piano, Robert Davis played the drum. It was six of us.

ctx.x: Who did you have in the band there? You had Jim as well.
Yeah, well Jim, Paul Barnes, Sidney Flusia played the guitar, Benny Turner played the piano, Robert Davis played the drum. It was six of us. That's what they said.
What did you say? You had clarinet or saxophone? Saxophone, Paul. Did he play clarinet at that time?
